If you want inspiration for experiments that move revenue, this is your shortlist. Browse these experiments to learn what works and design stronger tests.

Optimization Experiences showcases real CRO work from client projects. Each article explains what we found, what we changed, and how it affected conversions. These posts show our full process from audit to experiment rollout.

You’ll see how we locate data problems, prioritize issues, and design effective tests. We cover funnels in SaaS, e-commerce, and info products. The goal is to reveal how disciplined optimization works in the real world.

If you want to understand expert decision-making, this section helps. Use these stories to avoid common mistakes and spot profit leaks in your own funnel.

If you want accurate, up-to-date direction on how to use PostHog’s latest features in the real world, this is the category to bookmark.

Each article breaks down strengths, weaknesses, and hidden costs. We look at integration issues, reporting limits, and how each tool supports experimentation. This helps you choose a stack that actually works for your business model.

If you want a tool decision based on evidence, not hype, start here. Use these comparisons to build a stable and reliable analytics setup.
